title: I built ALHR: A tree based sparse attention system that achieves sub-quadratic inference while retaining accuracy. [P]
summary: ALHR - Adaptive Learnable Hierarchical Routing, uses static binary trees and learnable functions to minimize the amount of keys to be read. It does use a dense teacher while phase 1 of training however. MQAR TEST AT 1024 TOKENS - Average keys read per query by dense - 512 Keys Av
